law.catch_line: (Expires July 1, 2028) Chairman's executive summary of activity and work of the Commission
law.text: The chairman may submit to the General Assembly and the Governor an annual executive summary of the interim activity and work of the Commission no later than the first day of each regular session of the General Assembly. The executive summary may be submitted as provided in the procedures of the Division of Legislative Automated Systems for the processing of legislative documents and reports and may be posted on the General Assembly's website.
